name: Deja Vu
overview: The experience of deja vu can be understood in light of Scripture's teaching on God's sovereign knowledge and eternal plan. Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is nothing new under the sun, affirming the repetition and continuity in God's creation, while Jeremiah reveals that God knows and ordains our lives even before birth. This divine foreknowledge assures believers that every moment is part of God's perfect timing and purpose, as He has set the world in the human heart beyond full comprehension. Ultimately, God's love through Christ secures our place in His eternal plan, giving meaning beyond fleeting experiences.
